sources.title: Vals, backed by Andreessen Horowitz, is looking to become the gold standard for AI benchmarking
sources.claim: Vals AI raised $40M Series A led by a16z on August 13, 2026. The company positions as a neutral third-party AI benchmarking platform for enterprise procurement decisions. TechCrunch describes it as seeking to become 'the gold standard for AI benchmarking.'

sources.title: Vals AI Raises $40M in Series A Funding at $400M Valuation
sources.claim: Vals AI raised $40M Series A at $400M valuation on August 13, 2026, led by a16z with participation from HRT Ventures and Next Ladder Ventures. Total funding raised stands at $45M.

sources.title: The $800M Race to Own AI Agent Evaluation: Braintrust, Arize, Patronus, and the Infrastructure Layer Every Production Team Needs
sources.claim: Collective valuation of AI evaluation companies (Braintrust, Arize AI, Patronus AI, Galileo, Fiddler, HoneyHive, Scorecard) surpasses $2.2B. Documents 37% gap between lab benchmark scores and real-world production AI performance. LLM eval platform market reached $1.35B in 2024 and is projected to reach $8.2B by 2032 at 25.3% CAGR.

sources.title: Braintrust — 2026 Company Profile, Funding & Competitors
sources.claim: Braintrust closed $80M Series B in February 2026 at $800M post-money valuation, led by Iconiq with participation from a16z, Greylock, Basecase Capital, and Elad Gil. Customer list includes Notion, Replit, Cloudflare, Ramp, Dropbox, Vercel, Navan, and BILL.

sources.title: AI Model Evaluation Platform Market Size Report 2026-2030
sources.claim: AI Model Evaluation Platform market reached $2.36 billion in 2026, projected to grow to $6.24 billion by 2030 at a 27.5% CAGR. North America holds 46% market share in 2026.

sources.title: Large Language Model (LLM) Observability Platform Market Report 2026
sources.claim: LLM Observability Platform market valued at $2.69B in 2026, projected to reach $9.26B by 2030, growing at a 36.2% CAGR.

sources.title: Agent-eval startups: funding a benchmark nobody trusts
sources.claim: Patronus AI raised $50M Series B on June 25, 2026. Documents the market dynamic of enterprise agentic AI showing 37% gap between benchmark scores and production performance, validating evaluation infrastructure as a category.

sources.title: AI Benchmarks 2026: Top Evaluations and Their Limits
sources.claim: Documents benchmark saturation in 2026: frontier models including Gemini 3 Pro (~90.1%), Claude Opus 4.5 (~89.5%), and DeepSeek-V3.2 (~85.0%) are approaching the MMLU-Pro ceiling, rendering academic benchmarks increasingly meaningless for enterprise evaluation.

sources.title: Model Evaluation and Benchmarking Tools Market Size to Hit USD 9.57 Billion by 2035
sources.claim: Global model evaluation and benchmarking tools market is expanding from 2026 to approximately $9.57 billion by 2035 at a 9.57% CAGR. Gartner predicts 60% of software engineering teams will use AI evaluation and observability platforms by 2028, up from 18% in 2025.

sources.title: EU AI Act Regulations and Governance in 2026
sources.claim: EU AI Act enforcement begins August 2, 2026. High-risk AI systems must pass conformity assessments and maintain technical documentation. Models already on market before August 2, 2025 must comply by August 2, 2027. Four risk tiers defined: unacceptable, high, limited, and minimal risk.

sources.title: Compute Power AI — Technology Predictions 2026
sources.claim: Inference workloads account for roughly two-thirds of all AI compute in 2026, up from one-third in 2023 and half in 2025. The market for inference-optimized chips will grow to over $50B in 2026.

sources.title: The LLM Eval Vendor Buyer's Guide for 2026
sources.claim: Comprehensive 2026 buyer's guide for LLM evaluation platforms. Documents the three-tier market segmentation: open-source observability (Langfuse, Arize/Phoenix), evaluation and testing platforms (Patronus AI, Braintrust, Galileo), and governance/compliance platforms (Credo AI, Fiddler AI, Holistic AI).
